y_true.description: Ground truth values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.
constraints: The shapes of y_true and y_pred must be broadcast-compatible.

y_pred.description: The predicted values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.
constraints: The shapes of y_true and y_pred must be broadcast-compatible.

output.description: Mean absolute error values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN-1]`.

constraints: The shapes of y_true and y_pred must be broadcast-compatible.
